Hindustan Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 26, 2026, titled "Hindustan Foods Announces ₹100 Crore Greenfield Investment in Tamil Nadu under its Home & Personal Care Division".
voiceSummary: Hindustan Foods Limited announced an investment of approximately 100 crore rupees to set up a new greenfield manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu for Home Care Liquid products. This investment is part of the company's FY27 capex plan and aims to strengthen manufacturing capabilities in the Home and Personal Care division. The announcement states that this project is in addition to 400 crore rupees of ongoing investments communicated at the end of Q2 FY27. Consequently, the company expects its gross block to increase from 1,961 crore rupees as of September 2026 to 2,447 crore rupees by the next financial year. The disclosure was made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: MOIL Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: MOIL Limited filed a notice regarding the presentation made at its Investors and Analysts Meet on 26th November 2026. The company reported manganese ore output of 1.91 million tonnes for FY26. Total income for FY26 was Rs. 1,566 crore with EBITDA at Rs. 508 crore. MOIL remains fully debt-free with net worth of Rs. 2,709 crore as of 31st March 2026. The Government of India holds 53.35% shareholding. Capital expenditure for FY26 was Rs. 325 crore, with expected capex of Rs. 400 crore for FY27. Production is projected to grow to 35 lakh tonnes by 2029-30. The presentation included forward-looking statements and standard disclaimers regarding investment advice.

voiceSummary: Hero MotoCorp issued a press release regarding its partnership with Harley-Davidson. The companies are launching Mission The Big RIDE to mark 17 years of Harley-Davidson in India. The initiative focuses on enhancing customer experience, expanding the dealer footprint, and growing the product portfolio. Harley-Davidson will add two new full-line dealerships in Raipur and Indore, bringing the total network to 23 dealerships. Hero PREMIA outlets supporting Harley-Davidson X motorcycles have expanded to 152 outlets. The Harley-Davidson X range has contributed over 50,000 units since its launch in 2023. The cumulative customer base for Harley-Davidson in India has exceeded 80,000 motorcycles since dealer operations began in 2010. More than 100 Indian riders will participate in Asia Harley Days in Thailand on November 27–28, 2026.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed News Release of our Company
voiceSummary: Suven Life Sciences Limited announced the randomization of the first patient in its Global Phase-3 AWAKE study of Samelisant for Narcolepsy. The milestone occurred at a clinical site in the USA. The study evaluates Samelisant for Excessive Daytime Sleepiness in patients with Narcolepsy Type-1 and Type-2. The trial is conducted across North America and Europe. It plans to enroll approximately 240 adult patients. Enrollment of the last participant is anticipated by December 2027. Topline study results are expected in the first half of 2028. The primary objective is to evaluate efficacy using the Epworth Sleepiness Scale. ClinicalTrials.gov ID is NCT07540364.
